hook_en: He has always been your home. 🙏
reflect_en: Moses prayed to a God who was already there before the mountains were born, and who has been a dwelling place for every generation since. This Sunday, as you worship, you can rest in the One who was God before your story began and will be God long after this week is over.
q_en: Where do you need to find your rest in God this week?
x_en: Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
tiktok: Before the mountains were born, He was God 🙏 Psalm 90:1–2 — Lord, You have been our dwelling place
yt_title: From Everlasting to Everlasting You Are God | Psalm 90:1–2 #Shorts
yt_line: Make your home in Him today.
li_open: Leaders come and go; some things outlast every generation.
li_quote: Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
li_body: Moses led a restless people, yet he began this prayer by remembering that God Himself had been their dwelling place all along. Leaders who anchor their teams in something deeper than the latest plan, and who keep praying for the people in their care, give them a place to belong that doesn't shift with every season.
hook_es: Él siempre ha sido tu refugio. 🙏
reflect_es: Moisés oró al Dios que ya estaba ahí antes que naciesen los montes, y que ha sido refugio en generación y en generación. Este domingo, al adorarle, puedes descansar en Aquel que era Dios antes de que comenzara tu historia y que seguirá siendo Dios cuando esta semana termine.
q_es: ¿En qué área necesitas encontrar refugio en Dios esta semana?
x_es: Señor, tú nos has sido refugio en generación y en generación.
